integrity: Proof supplied in RESULT.md; exact-arithmetic finite checks supplied in verify_even_isolation.py. Computational tests do not replace the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: For even n>=4 at least one sign reversal, not global uniqueness except n=4. For odd n>=3 positivity only near p=1 and at p=1/2, not for every p. Dense asymptotics are fixed-n. Literature supplies the parity model and n=4 graph classes; earlier implicit statements remain possible.
title: A parity dichotomy for dense pair-isolation dependence in random even graphs
